0.4.10.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: When you come back, Home shows your recent chats and projects.
Private mode keeps a chat on this computer.
Backup and restore uses one file and does not include AI keys.
Do this again repeats a finished job and is part of Pro.
Double-check this asks a second AI to review an answer.
Tone buttons set the next answer only and do not send by themselves.
AI credits shows what is left for each AI. Each answer says which AI wrote it.
On a Mac with macOS 15 or later, open System Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Open Anyway.
Help search answers a plain question. Start here stays pinned. Back to all help returns to the list.
Large and Extra large text grow buttons, labels, headings, and chips. Simple setup asks Bigger text with a live preview.
Simple Settings starts with five cards: Your AI, Text and reading, Privacy, Your plan, and Get help. More options opens every other panel.
Reply, forward, share, and similar actions wait for a second click before they run.
The Simple tour has five short steps. See what else it can do opens the full tour.
My day in Simple opens Inbox and tasks, Day plan, and People.
Remove, Good, and Not good are written on those buttons.
A practice answer says it is from a pretend AI. Nothing was spent. Get real answers sits on that note.
This note shows once after an update. Take the tour again any time from Help, and from the Settings menu.

0.4.9.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: A share link made on this PC says this link only works on this PC. Copy the text or export a file.
Schedules use day buttons and a time. Presets include Weekdays at 5 pm and Fridays at 4 pm. Last run missed (app was closed) offers Run now.
Words from your never-say list, and guarantee when credit repair is on, are flagged before you copy or send.
Under the box, Meldmind says SSNs and account numbers are masked before sending.
Help includes Security and your data, plus a one-page security summary PDF.
MCP, OAuth, webhook, sender key, Handoff, and SCF mode use plain words. Each Handoff row says what happens.
The user guide says Meldmind. The installer is Meldmind-Setup.
Hint text is easier to read. Real estate and mortgage modes are coming. Marketplace stays capitalized.

Click Stop to cancel. Send says Still working while a run is going. Did not search the web when search is off. After 5 ratings, Meldmind says which AI it now prefers. A finished run can notify you in the background. You can type in any language. Nothing was charged on a failed run that cost $0.

New: let Meldmind use your desktop. It can use apps on this PC that have no API, after you allow each one. You confirm before a send, a buy, or a delete. A banner says Meldmind is using that app, with Stop. Passwords are not stored.

Google Antigravity is the first app. Install and connect runs Google's installer, then opens sign-in in your browser. You sign in once. Add to Antigravity writes the local connection only after you confirm.
The first setup screen has the same choice. After this update, the first launch shows the card. Not now reminds you once. Never hides it. You can change it later in Settings.
If a control in an app moves, Meldmind tries the other ways it knows to find it, then offers the manual handoff.
Desktop control lists programs on this PC. On Windows it reads the uninstall list and the Start menu, plus command-line tools on PATH. File contents are not read.
Each program is matched to a capability list you can update. Allow each app. Allowed apps are scored and join the router's choices, the same as a tool you add.
While you plan a mission or client work, a card suggests a program with a short reason, Free or Paid, and the official link. Dismiss hides that card. Nothing is installed or bought.
Turn suggestions off in Settings.
Program scan is part of Pro. On Free the list stays off.
Every weekday at 8: agenda, inbox, tasks, weather, and news. The briefing only reads. Weather and news are not fetched. A second routine is Pro.
Turn this email into a task and a calendar hold. Saving writes both on this computer. Google Calendar is not written.
Find 3 open 30 min slots next week for Ana. The email stays a draft until you click Send.
Upload a file, a screenshot, or a document with an idea. Voice turns speech into text you can edit before Send.
You can edit, delete, and re-prioritize an idea, add a comment, and set a status: new, planned, building, or shipped.
Marching orders has the same Upload and Voice buttons. Nothing is sent until you click Send.
Attach a picture or a video and ask Meldmind to modify it. You see the plan, then click Run. Preview, download, or save the result.
What's new offers each new connection and each new action. Try it runs a sample and does not send. Skip hides that row. Remind me later waits 3 days, then 7 days, then the row moves to Settings.
Suggest a connection or idea from Settings. You read the exact note, then click Send. Chat is not included.
Google Calendar sign-in still starts only from the checklist row. Nothing connects from the What's new card.
Find the Q3 proposal and summarize it. The search reads Google Drive and Notion when they are connected, and docs on this computer otherwise. Saving a copy stays on this computer.
Prep me for my 2pm. A transcript summary lists action items. Adding those to-dos is a separate click. This build does not record calls.
When a new HighLevel lead comes in, draft a text and email. Send is one click for one channel. Twilio was not contacted and no price was looked up.
Saving a project from the command bar stays on that page. Saved appears briefly, with Open if you want the project.
Run in background is Pro. Leave this screen. You get an alert when the chat, council, or mission is done. Nothing is emailed.
Settings shows what your ratings taught. Thumbs up and thumbs down change who gets the next job of that kind. Reset clears only the thumbs. Council scores stay.
Pro can pause a mission, edit the steps that have not finished, and resume. Done steps stay as they are.
A public share link is a Pro page anyone with the link can open. Costs and keys stay off unless you tick show costs. Nothing is posted until you copy the link.
Export a finished answer as a PDF or a Word document. Headings, bold text, and lists stay in the file. Export is part of Pro.
Industry packs cover real estate, mortgage, credit repair, and creators. Credit repair follows CROA and does not promise a score change. Outbound text stays a draft.
Settings, Reading, adds a text size and a high-contrast mode. Read aloud is on an answer and speaks only when you click it.
Name an imported ChatGPT or Claude conversation in the chat and Meldmind uses that conversation as context.
Extreme adds early access, Max quality, and five team seats. Lifetime for the first 100 founders is $349. Pro, Extreme, and lifetime pay links are published.

Connect Zapier from the Simple chat card, or connect Zapier and Make in Expert. Their actions can run in a chat or a mission after you click Allow. A Meldmind webhook can start a chat, a council, or a mission and return the result.
This note shows once after an update. Take the tour again any time from Settings.

0.4.8.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: The top bar uses the width it has. A wide window shows about eight menus on one row. A narrower window shows about five. The row never wraps onto a second line.

Nova, Atlas and Sage hide from every list and from the hub once a real AI is connected, including a saved key, a local model, OpenRouter, or agy. They come back only when every real AI is removed. You can turn demo mode back on in Settings.
This note shows once after an update. Take the tour again any time from Settings.

0.4.7.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: The top bar is one row of dropdown menus. A wider window splits them into more menus, and a narrower window merges them back. The row never wraps onto a second line. Resizing the window or moving it to another monitor updates the row right away.
Start a project is in the Work menu, with Projects. The Settings menu keeps Settings, setup, the tour, and Check for updates.

Nova, Atlas and Sage are the demo AIs. They hide once a real AI key or a real AI is connected, and they come back only when every real AI is removed. Real jobs are not sent to those demo AIs while a real AI is connected.
This note shows once after an update. Take the tour again any time from Settings.

0.4.6.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: Pro yearly is $159 a year. Lifetime founder is $299 for the first 100, then $499, and it stops at 500. Those buttons do not charge.
While the app is open it checks again every hour. That prompt says Restart and update and Later. Later downloads the update and installs it when you quit.
A packaged install includes what the engine needs to start. If the app did not open, install this update.

0.4.5.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: Settings, Appearance, adds theme presets, gradients, built-in pictures, and a photo from a file on this computer. A web address is not accepted. Built-in restores the original background.
The top bar shows You saved this month and all time. It is an estimate based on token counts and list prices.
Add a custom provider and tick Good at for the task types it should take. Matching tasks go to it. Scores from your jobs make the pick sharper.

0.4.4.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: Free includes 3 projects and 5 councils a month, 1 connected service, and 1 email account per provider. Pro includes every connected service and up to 8 email accounts.
Phone pairing and full history search are Pro. The router stays free. Shared learning and the scores dashboard are Pro.
A 14-day Pro trial can be started in the app. The trial is not started for you, and nothing is charged.
Quality, Balanced, Max savings, and Speed apply to Single, Council, and Mission.
A connected free model on this PC (Ollama, LM Studio, Aider, OpenCode) is tried first on Max savings. Freebuff is not used.
The route preview can mention a batch price. A run you send now pays the live price.
Add community track records from people who opted in. Quality, Balanced, Max savings, and Speed all learn from them. Nothing is uploaded.
Settings, Appearance, sets a background colour next to the accent. Built-in restores the original background. Text stays readable.
This note shows once after an update. Take the tour again any time from Settings.

0.4.0.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: The app is now called Meldmind. It is still an Everborn product. Take command of all your AIs.
The top bar is grouped dropdown menus: Work, Create, Business, Connect, and Settings.
Council is on the order box: several AIs answer, review each other, and a chair writes the verdict.
Pro prompts are written by our team. Auto-detect can suggest one from what you type, and you can remove that chip.
Open live view sits at the bottom-right of Live Ops.
Connect an API key, or an MCP server, from the Connect menu.
Pipelines and scheduled agents are in the Work menu. A scheduled result that would be sent waits until you approve it.
Publishing shows a preview first. Nothing posts until you confirm.

0.4.1.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: The app is now called Meldmind. It is still an Everborn product. Take command of all your AIs.
The top bar is grouped dropdown menus: Work, Create, Business, Connect, and Settings.
Pro prompts are written by our team. Auto-detect can suggest one from what you type, and you can remove that chip.

Drop a PDF, Word doc, text file, or image into a project. Meldmind reads it, shows the estimate, and later answers can cite the file.
A mission can include a video, an image, or a voice clip. You see the price first. A paid step waits until you click Approve.

0.4.3.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: Simple and Expert. A new install starts in Simple: one chat box, and the council picks the AI.
The first time you open Meldmind it asks: Keep it simple or show me everything?
A Simple / Expert switch sits in the top bar on every screen. One click changes it. Your chats, projects, and keys stay put.
Simple shows Chat, Projects, Create, and Settings. Expert keeps the debate, the scores, spend caps, the live map, marketplace, MCP, webhooks, and every menu.
The chips under the chat box list only AIs you have connected. Demo stays there only until a real AI is connected.
Pasting a key recognizes Gemini auth keys (AQ.) and older AIza keys, plus Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenRouter, and Groq. Gemini is checked on Google's own models list.
Help is a tab in Simple and in Expert. Search the guides, or click Ask Meldmind. Take the tour again and Check for updates are both there.
Phone pairing uses this PC's Wi-Fi address when you turn it on in Settings, under Phone and other devices. The QR code and the link both include the pairing code. It stays off until you turn it on.
Out of credits, a spending limit, or a rate limit pauses that AI. The strip says Paused: no credits, with a billing link. Auto-picks skip it until a health check clears it or you save the key again.
CapCut connects with its MCP sign-in, not an API key. The strip says Not connected until you Connect, then Connected. If it cannot connect, the card says US access is coming soon.
Each provider shows how it connects: No key, Not connected, Handoff, or Local app.
Set a provider to Free, Paid, or Unknown. Simple mode can prefer free AIs when quality is similar.
After a run, one upgrade tip can name an AI that usually does that task better, with a link to add credits or a key. Tips stay off during a run.
Out of credits is no longer shown as Key rejected. A spending limit or an empty balance says to top up, and the key stays saved.
Tap to talk works in the desktop app. It transcribes with an OpenAI, Groq, ElevenLabs, or Gemini key, and it names the key to add when none is saved.

A fresh install shows Get everything connected after the AI setup: Gmail, Drive, Calendar, HighLevel, CapCut, Kling, and the rest. Each row is Connected, Not connected, or Handoff. Gmail and Outlook list each account. Add another asks for a label, then uses the same sign-in. Run setup again is in Settings and in the Help menu.
The AI keys step leads with one OpenRouter key. It reaches Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama and more, and free models are available. Other keys stay optional.

A new setup checks I am willing to share anonymous track records. Meldmind learns from every job you run. Anonymous track records help it pick the best AI for everyone. What we share is only the task type, which AI, and the score. We never share prompts, content, or keys. You can change this any time in Settings. If you clear it: Meldmind learns from the community. With this off, your jobs won't help make it smarter for everyone, but you'll still benefit from what others share.
This note shows once after an update. Take the tour again any time from Settings.

0.4.2.title: What's new in Meldmind
bullets: Connect Google Drive, Instagram, HighLevel and Slack with your own sign-in, in Settings, Publishing. Every post, schedule or save shows a preview and waits for your click.
Services that offer both, such as Kling, can connect with an API key or an MCP server.
Marketplace: browse and install signed templates, or share one of your own pipelines.
Steadier app: clearer error messages, empty screens that say what to do next, keyboard and screen reader fixes, and a user guide.
